extraction.name: SciQ
extraction.description: A dataset of 13.7K multiple choice science exam questions crowdsourced using a novel method that leverages a large corpus of domain-specific text and a small set of existing questions.
extraction.creator: Johannes Welbl, Nelson F. Liu, Matt Gardner
extraction.citeAs: Welbl, J., Liu, N. F., & Gardner, M. (2017). Crowdsourcing Multiple Choice Science Questions. arXiv preprint arXiv:1707.06209.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Crowdsourcing via Amazon Mechanical Turk. Workers were shown filtered textbook paragraphs and asked to generate questions. Then another set of workers selected distractors aided by a model.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Crowdsourcing, Manual Human Curator, Software Collection
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Science study textbooks from CK-12 and OpenStax under Creative Commons License, and other online learning resources.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: A rule-based document filter was applied to paragraphs to remove irrelevant sentences (e.g., questions, exclamations, sentences with modal verbs, etc.).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: First task: workers generated questions from filtered paragraphs. Second task: workers validated questions and selected/wrote distractors, aided by a model that ranked candidate distractors.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Workers were allowed to reject all three presented documents (12.1% rejection rate). Distractor model achieved 94.2% validation accuracy. Workers accepted model-generated distractors about 36.1% of the time.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: 1 (one question per paragraph) for first task; second task produced 3 distractors per question.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Amazon Mechanical Turk workers with Master's status; 175 workers participated in the whole project.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Random forest classifier for distractor ranking; scikit-learn implementation.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Dataset is limited to science exam questions; neural models did not outperform simple IR baselines on multiple choice version; direct answer version slightly smaller due to unreleasable texts.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation; used for multiple choice science QA and direct answer reading comprehension; shown to improve performance on real 4th and 8th grade science exam questions when used as additional training data.
